name: IL-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with +18 partisan lean
Incumbent Jonathan Jackson running with large fundraising edge
Republican challenger underfunded with minimal resources
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~95%
model.rationale: The district's +18 Democratic lean, Jackson's incumbency and roughly seven-to-one fundraising advantage, and markets pricing a Democratic win near 95% all point to a comfortable hold. With no polls or expert ratings available, the forecast rests on these fundamentals, which uniformly favor Jackson.
model.watch: A major outside-spending intervention for Maxwell or an unexpected scandal involving Jackson would be the main ways this race could tighten.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jonathan Jackson, the Democratic incumbent in this Chicago-area district, is seeking another term against Republican Christian Maxwell. The seat sits in territory that leans about 18 points Democratic, and Jackson has out-raised his challenger by a wide margin while holding the advantages of incumbency. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race.

Prediction markets price Jackson's chances at roughly 95%, and the fundamentals point the same direction. The Republican campaign has limited funds and no visible outside support, making an upset highly unlikely in this safely Democratic seat.
